name: last_final_sudoku_standard_benchmark
description: A benchmark of standard Sudoku instances intended to evaluate systems' ability to produce complete, valid Sudoku solutions. It measures combinatorial reasoning and constraint-satisfaction capability by checking whether generated grids satisfy Sudoku rules. Useful for assessing both learned models and search/solver hybrid approaches.
reputation: Niche benchmark used in reinforcement-learning, program synthesis and reasoning research to evaluate puzzle-solving and combinatorial generalization.
